text: TechHub Electronics accepts returns within 14 days of delivery for any reason. Items must be returned in their original condition and packaging. Refunds are processed within 5 business days of receiving the returned item. For items that arrive damaged or defective, we offer free returns and either a full replacement or refund at the customer's choice. Proof of purchase (order confirmation) must be provided. Return shipping is free for damaged/defective items and costs £3.99 for change-of-mind returns. We comply fully with the Consumer Rights Act 2015 and the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013.
